affordances.name: Michelle 3D Model
affordances.semantic: Animated character model at scene center performing dance movements

affordances.name: BarramundiFish School
affordances.semantic: Five instanced fish models orbiting around Michelle in circular formation

affordances.name: Timeline Bar
affordances.semantic: Horizontal timeline with 8 clickable keyframe slots at bottom of screen

affordances.name: Fish Orbit Radius Slider
affordances.semantic: Radial slider controlling distance of fish orbit from Michelle (1-4 units)

affordances.name: Fish Velocity Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider controlling angular velocity of fish orbital motion (0.5-3 rad/s)

affordances.name: Coupling Multiplier Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider setting the multiplier linking fish velocity to Michelle animation speed (0.5x-2x)

affordances.name: Undo/Redo Buttons
affordances.semantic: Buttons to undo or redo choreography editing actions

affordances.name: Keyframe Panel
affordances.semantic: Panel appearing when keyframe selected, containing pose blend weight slider

states.name: Initial Load
states.description: Scene loaded with Michelle and fish at default positions, no keyframes placed

states.name: First Keyframe Placed
states.description: User has placed at least one keyframe on timeline, keyframe panel visible

states.name: Fish Orbit Adjusted
states.description: Fish orbit radius has been modified from default value

states.name: Velocity Coupling Active
states.description: Fish velocity changed and Michelle animation speed automatically adjusted via coupling

states.name: Energy Conservation Enforced
states.description: Total kinetic energy computed and coupling constraint actively maintained

states.name: Undo History Available
states.description: Multiple actions performed, undo stack contains reversible operations

states.name: Complex Choreography
states.description: Multiple keyframes placed with varied pose weights and coupled motion parameters

postconditions: First keyframe is placed on timeline
Keyframe count increases from 0 to 1
Active keyframe index is set to valid slot

action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if(slider && slider.id.includes('radius')) { slider.value = 3; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Fish orbit radius is modified to larger value
Fish positions update to reflect new orbit radius

action.code: const slider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.id.includes('velocity')); if(slider) { slider.value = 2; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Fish orbital velocity is increased
Michelle animation speed automatically adjusts via coupling
Coupling is marked as active
Total kinetic energy is computed and stored
Energy conservation constraint is enforced
Michelle animation speed reflects coupled relationship

action.code: const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.timeline-slot'); if(slots[2]) slots[2].click(); setTimeout(() => { if(slots[4]) slots[4].click(); }, 500);

postconditions: Multiple keyframes placed creating action history
Undo stack depth increases
Redo stack is cleared after new actions

action.code: const blendSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.id.includes('blend') || s.id.includes('pose')); if(blendSlider) { blendSlider.value = 0.7; blendSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Pose blend weight is adjusted for active keyframe
Complex choreography state with multiple parameters configured
All state fields contain valid values

action.code: const couplingSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(s => s.id.includes('coupling') || s.id.includes('multiplier')); if(couplingSlider) { couplingSlider.value = 1.5; couplingSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Coupling multiplier is adjusted
Michelle animation speed recalculates based on new multiplier
System remains in stable choreography state
Scene remains stable for 60 seconds
All animations continue smoothly
State values remain valid and within bounds
